**OFFICE NOTE**

**To:** All Heads of Departments
**From:** The Registrar
**Subject:** Diwali Holiday Closure

This is to inform all Heads of Departments that the Institute will remain closed on 8 November 2026 in observance of the Diwali holiday.

Consequently, all official work and administrative activities will be suspended on this date. Regular academic classes and institutional operations are scheduled to resume on 9 November 2026.

All HODs are requested to ensure that necessary arrangements are made regarding security and maintenance during the closure period. Staff members are advised to plan their schedules accordingly.

Please disseminate this information to all concerned faculty and non-teaching staff under your jurisdiction.

**Registrar**

Office of the Dean (Academics)
Circular No. ACAD/2026/117                                             4 October 2026
Subject: Revision of the mid-semester examination timetable
All Heads of Departments are informed that the mid-semester examinations scheduled from 13 October 2026
will now commence on 19 October 2026 owing to the state holiday on 14 October. The revised timetable is
attached. Departments shall display it on their notice boards and inform students through the portal
by 9 October 2026. Invigilation duty rosters already circulated remain valid with dates shifted by
three days. Queries may be addressed to the Examination Section (ext. 2210).
Sd/- Dean (Academics)

First, the convener must conduct a thorough self-assessment to ensure all departmental records, including course files, examination papers, and faculty portfolios, are complete and organized. Next, they should schedule a preparatory meeting with faculty members to clarify expectations, assign specific documentation responsibilities, and address any potential gaps in compliance. It is also crucial to review the audit criteria and institutional guidelines to anticipate likely questions and ensure consistent messaging across the department. Finally, the convener should prepare a concise presentation highlighting key achievements, ongoing improvements, and any challenges the department is addressing. This proactive approach demonstrates transparency and readiness, facilitating a smooth and productive audit process.
